$comment: Known defects in plugins the auditor was NOT allowed to edit.
`tools/audit.mjs` exits 0 when every failure it finds is listed here, and
exits 1 for anything new. A baselined entry is PRINTED on every run under
'BASELINED (known, unfixed)' so it stays visible instead of becoming a
silent allowlist, and the audit fails if an entry stops failing — that is
how a fixed defect gets its entry deleted rather than lingering forever.
Remove an entry only after the underlying bug is fixed and re-verified.
fixed by the Lead once that plugin's writer finished — the disposer is now
returned — and the audit's reverse check proved the exemption no longer
reproduces, which is what forced this deletion.
